name: Betrayal from Within
summary: In the central Barrens, the hunt for Lok Orcbane reaches its end. His fall will weaken the Razormane raids, and you carry his severed head to Thork at the Crossroads.

sections.title: A Traitor's Head
sections.body: Mangletooth, a captured Razormane quilboar held in a cage at Camp Taurajo, names Lok Orcbane as the chieftain directing attacks on Horde caravans. After you slay Lok deep in the southern thorn mazes, Mangletooth gives you the chieftain's skull. He finds it amusing that the orcs will benefit from betrayal within the tribe without knowing a captive quilboar helped them.

sections.title: Securing the Crossroads
sections.body: You bring Lok's head north to Thork at the Crossroads, easing the pressure on Horde supply lines across the central savannah. Thork is astonished that one traveler felled so formidable a leader; he had expected another mastermind behind the organized strikes. Lok's death leaves the Razormane offensive fractured and its fighters disorganized.

faq.answer: Mangletooth is a captured Razormane quilboar kept in a wooden cage at Camp Taurajo. Bitter that his tribe abandoned him, he guides Horde adventurers against its warlords for revenge.
Lok Orcbane was a prominent Razormane chieftain who coordinated fierce ambushes against Horde outposts and supply lines across the Barrens.

faq.q: Why does Thork care about Lok's death?
faq.answer: Thork commands the defense of the Crossroads against persistent thorn-dwelling raiders. Lok Orcbane directed attacks along the Gold Road, and his death removes their primary tactician.

faq.q: Why did Mangletooth help eliminate his own chieftain?
faq.answer: Mangletooth is deeply bitter toward his tribe's leadership and respects raw strength above kin. He guides Horde champions to execute Lok, indulging his hatred while keeping his mystical connection to Agamaggan from behind bars.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain lead?
aliases: next quest after betrayal from within
faq.answer: You bring Lok's head to mark the end of the immediate assassination chain. Mangletooth still trades Agamaggan's elemental blessings for Blood Shards gathered from quilboar across the Barrens.
Thork is on guard inside the Crossroads settlement in the northern central Barrens, overseeing defense and logistics.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you help secure the travel corridors between Camp Taurajo and the Crossroads. Lok Orcbane's death blunts the Razormanes' threat to new settlements in Kalimdor.
As an orc, you hear a warning in Lok's surname: Orcbane. He has long butchered orcish settlers and supply convoys in the arid flats.
